title: Localqw6 Guest gui by Omer
script:
-- GUI'nin Ana Bölümü
local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
local MainFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
local UIListLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")

ScreenGui.Parent = game.Players.LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
ScreenGui.Name = "CustomGUI"

MainFrame.Parent = ScreenGui
MainFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0.2, 0.2, 0.2)
MainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 300, 0, 400)
MainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -150, 0.5, -200)
MainFrame.Draggable = true
MainFrame.Active = true

UIListLayout.Parent = MainFrame
UIListLayout.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Vertical
UIListLayout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
UIListLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 5)

-- Butonları Oluşturma Fonksiyonu
local function createButton(name, callback)
    local Button = Instance.new("TextButton")
    Button.Parent = MainFrame
    Button.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40)
    Button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0.4, 0.4, 0.4)
    Button.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    Button.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSans
    Button.TextSize = 18
    Button.Text = name
    Button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(callback)
end

-- 1. Buton: GUEST SAVAŞÇI KEYBOARD AÇ
createButton("GUEST SAVAŞÇI KEYBOARD AÇ", function()
    loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://rawscripts.net/raw/The-Strongest-Battlegrounds-Anti-Furry-script-11335"))()
end)

-- 2. Buton: Güneş Enerjisi
createButton("Güneş Enerjisi", function()
    local Sun = Instance.new("Part")
    Sun.Parent = workspace
    Sun.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
    Sun.Size = Vector3.new(10, 10, 10)
    Sun.Position = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.Head.Position + Vector3.new(0, 20, 0)
    Sun.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Bright yellow")
    Sun.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
    game:GetService("RunService").RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if Sun and game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character then
            Sun.Position = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.Head.Position + Vector3.new(0, 20, 0)
        end
    end)
end)

-- 3. Buton: Kılıç
createButton("Kılıç", function()
    loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://rawscripts.net/raw/Universal-Script-Grab-knife-v4-24753"))()
end)

-- 4. Buton: FE Coolkidd
createButton("FE Coolkidd", function()
    loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://rawscripts.net/raw/Universal-Script-c00lkiddo-f3x-24239"))()
    loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://rawscripts.net/raw/Universal-Script-c00lkidd-24380"))()
end)

-- 5. Buton: GUI'lerim
createButton("GUI'lerim", function()
    local GuiFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
    GuiFrame.Parent = ScreenGui
    GuiFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0.3, 0.3, 0.3)
    GuiFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 300, 0, 300)
    GuiFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -150, 0.5, -150)
    GuiFrame.Draggable = true
    GuiFrame.Active = true

    local CloseButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
    CloseButton.Parent = GuiFrame
    CloseButton.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40)
    CloseButton.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -40)
    CloseButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 0, 0)
    CloseButton.Text = "Kapat"
    CloseButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        GuiFrame:Destroy()
    end)

    -- İçindeki Butonlar
    local function createInnerButton(name, scriptUrl)
        local InnerButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
        InnerButton.Parent = GuiFrame
        InnerButton.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40)
        InnerButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0.5, 0.5, 0.5)
        InnerButton.Text = name
        InnerButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            loadstring(game:HttpGet(scriptUrl))()
        end)
    end

    createInnerButton("Guest GUI v1", "https://rawscripts.net/raw/Universal-Script-Localqw6-guest-lere-scripst-23528")
    createInnerButton("Tüm SC Alıcı", "https://rawscripts.net/raw/Universal-Script-Localqw6-gui-v3-23321")
end)

-- 6. Buton: Yeni HiperSarj
createButton("YENİ HİPERSARJ", function()
    local Ball = Instance.new("Part")
    Ball.Parent = workspace
    Ball.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
    Ball.Size = Vector3.new(5, 5, 5)
    Ball.Position = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.Head.Position
    Ball.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Really red")
    Ball.Material = Enum.Material.Neon

    local BodyAngularVelocity = Instance.new("BodyAngularVelocity")
    BodyAngularVelocity.Parent = Ball
    BodyAngularVelocity.AngularVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 5, 0)
    BodyAngularVelocity.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(4000, 4000, 4000)

    wait(5)
    Ball.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Really black")
    Ball:Destroy()
end)

-- 7. Buton: HİNT
createButton("HİNT", function()
    print("Hint: xxxomer12345678 GAME NUKERRR LLLLLLLLL")
end)

-- 9. Buton: ANİMASYON
createButton("ANİMASYON", function()
    local Animation = Instance.new("Animation")
    Animation.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://12776186075"
    local Humanoid = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
    if Humanoid then
        local Track = Humanoid:LoadAnimation(Animation)
        Track:Play()
    end
end)
